name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.Direct.rsd_nand_relaxation
title: Regular syndrome decoding encoding of NAND circuits: for any gate triples, F_2 block solutions exist with total weight G + 2 * #violated gates
statement: Encode a NAND gate with input bits a, b and output bit c by a block u in F_2^4 (columns 00, 01, 10, 11) under the F_2-linear constraints u0 + u1 + u2 + u3 = 1, u2 + u3 = a, u1 + u3 = b, u0 + u1 + u2 = c. For any G and any triples (a g, b g, c g) in F_2^3, there are blocks u g satisfying all these constraints whose total Hamming weight is G + 2 * #{g : c g != 1 + a g b g}. So in the regular-syndrome-decoding encoding of a false circuit (honest evaluation with the output forced to 1), a solution of weight t + 2 exists, where t is the weight of a regular (true-witness) solution.
